[[2011 Liga Primer Indonesia|2011 LPI]] | nextseason = [[2014 Indonesia Super League|2014]] }} The '''2013 Indonesia Super League''' was the 5th season of the [[Indonesia Super League]] (ISL), a fully professional football competition as the top tier of the [[Association football|football]] league pyramid in [[Indonesia]]. The season began on 5 January 2013. [[Sriwijaya F.C.|Sriwijaya]] were the defending champions, having won their second [[List of Indonesian football champions|league title]]. This season was also the first season of ISL organized with authorization from the [[Football Association of Indonesia|Joint Committee of PSSI]] until the establishment of a new league. After the signing of the [[Memorandum of understanding|MoU]] between [[Djohar Arifin Husin]] (PSSI) and [[La Nyalla Matalitti]] (KPSI-PSSI) that was initiated by [[FIFA]] and the [[Asian Football Confederation|AFC]] through the [[Asian Football Confederation]]'s Task Force, now Indonesia Super League was under the control of the Joint Committee to remain manageable by ''PT Liga Indonesia'' until the establishment of a new professional competition by the committee.{{cite web|url=http://bolanews.com/read/sepakbola/indonesia/8968-Dua-PSSI-Sepakat-Perbaiki-Sepak-Bola-Indonesia.html|title=Dua PSSI sepakat perbaiki sepakbola Indonesia|publisher=bolanews.com|access-date=7 June 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140222223149/http://bolanews.com/read/sepakbola/indonesia/8968-Dua-PSSI-Sepakat-Perbaiki-Sepak-Bola-Indonesia.html|archive-date=22 February 2014|url-status=usurped}} In the original plan the league season would have begun in November. But to honor the results of the joint committee meeting, the league schedule was postponed.{{cite web|last=Aruan|first=Frengky|title=Hormati Poin KB, PT LI Undur ISL|url=http://www.bolanews.com/read/sepakbola/indonesia/16218-Hormati-Poin-KB-PT-LI-Undur-ISL.html|work=bolanews.com|publisher=Bola|access-date=25 September 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120927052249/http://bolanews.com/read/sepakbola/indonesia/16218-Hormati-Poin-KB-PT-LI-Undur-ISL.html|archive-date=27 September 2012|url-status=usurped}} At a meeting with club participants decided that the league would precisely start at 5 January 2013 and end on 18 September of the same year.{{cite web|last=Afroni|first=Donny|title=Indonesia Super League Bergulir 5 Januari|url=http://www.goal.com/id-ID/news/1387/nasional/2012/09/29/3411037/indonesia-super-league-bergulir-5-januari|publisher=Goal|access-date=29 September 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121002095645/http://www.goal.com/id-ID/news/1387/nasional/2012/09/29/3411037/indonesia-super-league-bergulir-5-januari|archive-date=2 October 2012|url-status=dead}} ==Teams== [[PSMS Medan|PSMS]], [[Deltras F.C.|Deltras]] and [[PSAP Sigli]] were relegated during the end of the [[2011–12 Indonesia Super League|previous season]]. They were replaced by the best three teams from the [[2011–12 Liga Indonesia Premier Division (LI)]], [[PS Barito Putera|Barito Putera]], [[Persita Tangerang|Persita]] and [[Persepam Pamekasan]]. Fourth-placed Premier Division sides [[PSIM Yogyakarta|PSIM]] failed to be promoted to the [[Indonesia Super League]] after being defeated by the 15th-placed finishers of [[2011–12 Indonesia Super League]], [[Gresik United]] by score 3–1. Indonesian Premier League Champion (IPL) season 2011/2012, Semen Padang finally officially returned to the Indonesia Super League (ISL). The Return of Semen Padang to ISL was known as ''PT Liga Indonesia'' issued numbered 01010/Liga/X/2012, regarding the delivery status of Semen Padang.{{cite web|title=PT LI Akhirnya Setujui Semen Padang Kembali ke ISL|url=http://www.bolaindo.com/2012/10/11/pt-li-akhirnya-setujui-semen-padang-kembali-ke-isl/|work=bolaindo.com|publisher=Bolaindo|access-date=11 October 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121012223730/http://www.bolaindo.com/2012/10/11/pt-li-akhirnya-setujui-semen-padang-kembali-ke-isl/|archive-date=12 October 2012|url-status=dead}} Finalize participant Indonesia Super League (ISL) season 2013 was completed on 30 October 2012.
